useCase.name: Control who can see an employee's salary and who can see the full staff record, everywhere it could appear

intent.name: staff.visibility.right.set
intent.summary: Set which roles hold a staff-record or salary visibility right. Super Admin only, one step, and it takes effect at once.
routesHere: give Accounts the right to see any salary

routesHere.text: Accounts ko har tankhwah dekhne ka haq de do
routesHere.gloss: give Accounts the right to see any salary

routesHere.text: School Admin se tankhwah dekhne ka haq wapas le lo
routesHere.gloss: take the salary-viewing right away from the School Admin

routesHere.text: poora staff record kaun dekh sakta hai, wo set karo
routesHere.gloss: set who can see the full staff record

request.text: ek mulazim ki tankhwah dekhni hai
request.gloss: I want to see one employee's salary

routesElsewhere.note: This sets who holds a right. It does not grant a look at a particular record.

request.gloss: I want to see my own salary

routesElsewhere.note: An employee's own salary is always visible to them, whatever the configuration says. A person is entitled to know what they are paid (BR-9).

request.text: report se tankhwah ka column hata do
request.gloss: remove the salary column from the report

routesElsewhere.note: Where a report would contain a salary the requester may not see, the column is omitted automatically and the rest of the report is still produced (BR-10).

steps.note: One step, and it applies everywhere at once. The configuration is read at the moment of each request, so a change takes effect immediately rather than at the next sign-in (BR-11).

plan.onFailure: Stop and report. A change that would make payroll impossible, and one that would remove the Super Admin's own right, are both refused.
plan.atomicity: One write: the roles holding the right, with who changed it and when (BR-7). It applies wherever a salary can appear — the staff record, a payroll run, a list, a report or an export (BR-5). Hiding is not filtering after the fact: a role without the right never receives the figure, rather than receiving it and having it hidden in the interface (BR-8).

operations.name: staff.visibility.right.set
operations.idempotencyKey: right, since a right carries one set of roles
operations.purpose: Set which roles hold one visibility right.

parameters.name: right
parameters.type: enum: See the full staff record | See any salary | Maintain the general record | See own salary only
parameters.notes: Which right is being configured (BR-6). The rights are not written into the software.

parameters.name: roles
parameters.notes: The roles that hold it. The complete list, not an addition — a role absent from it loses the right. Every name is the Super Admin's, because this decides who sees what people are paid.

parameters.name: branch_id
parameters.notes: Never from the request, even where the request names a campus or a past year (branch-scope, academic-session-scope).

fields.name: roles_added
fields.description: Roles that did not hold it before.

fields.name: roles_removed
fields.description: Roles that held it and now do not.

fields.name: effective
fields.description: At once. The configuration is read at the moment of each request (BR-11).

fields.name: surfaces
fields.description: Everywhere it is enforced — the record, a payroll run, a list, a report and an export (BR-5).

errors.meaning: The change would leave no role able to run payroll.
A non-Super Admin attempted to change the configuration.
errors.note: The Super Admin sets which roles hold each right (BR-6).

errors.meaning: The Super Admin removed their own right to see the record.
errors.note: Nobody could then restore the configuration (E6).

planningRules.rule: Never add or remove a role the actor did not name. The list is complete rather than incremental, and a role dropped in passing loses sight of every salary in the school from that moment (BR-6, BR-11).
Report the roles added and removed, by name. A configuration change is stated as a list, and what actually changed is the part that matters.
Say that it takes effect at once. The configuration is read at each request, so somebody loses or gains sight of salaries immediately rather than at their next sign-in (BR-11).
Never describe the rule as hiding a figure in the interface. A role without the right never receives it (BR-8) — that is what makes an export as safe as a screen (BR-5).
Never plan a change that leaves payroll unrunnable or the Super Admin locked out. E2 and E6 exist because a configuration nobody can operate or restore is worse than any leak it prevents.

reversal.statement: A right is set again rather than withdrawn, and every change is recorded with who made it and when (BR-7). A change nobody can trace is a change nobody can question.

request.text: Accounts ko har tankhwah dekhne ka haq de do
request.gloss: give Accounts the right to see any salary

resolvedPlans.context: Super Admin. Accounts and the Principal are to hold it.

inputs.roles: the complete list the Super Admin named — Principal and Accounts

steps.note: The list is complete, not an addition to what was there (PR-1).

resolvedPlans.outcome: Set. Report which roles were added and which lost the right (PR-2), and that it applies at once on the record, on payroll runs, on lists, on reports and on exports (PR-3).

request.text: Accounts ko bhi shamil kar lo

resolvedPlans.context: Super Admin, on a right currently held by the Principal alone.

inputs.roles: $request.roles — the complete list, which the actor has not stated

steps.note: No plan is emitted until the full list is confirmed (PR-1).

resolvedPlans.outcome: Nothing is set. Report who holds the right now and confirm the complete list — the call replaces the list, so sending Accounts alone would take the right away from the Principal.

request.text: School Admin ko bhi tankhwah dekhne do, un ko kaam ke liye chahiye
request.gloss: let the School Admin see salaries too, they need it for their work

inputs.roles: the complete list including School Admin, as stated

resolvedPlans.outcome: Set as asked. Worth reporting that the School Admin is also the role that sets salaries in the salary use case, and that the same document says the two cannot both hold — granting this resolves a contradiction the documents flag rather than creating one, and it is the Super Admin's decision to make.
